name: agent-harness
description: Template repository for an AWS-hosted, bounded-loop coding agent. Companion to the published post on runtime vs. engineering harnesses.

scripts.test: npm test -w @agent-harness/fanout && npm test -w @agent-harness/shared && npm test -w @agent-harness/post-deploy && npm test -w @agent-harness/editor && npm test -w @agent-harness/reviewer && npm test -w @agent-harness/loop
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run build -w @agent-harness/shared && npm run build -w @agent-harness/post-deploy && npm run build -w @agent-harness/editor && npm run build -w @agent-harness/reviewer && npm run build -w @agent-harness/loop
